Hi Sara,

Hope you're well — I'm Lauren on the Redwood partnerships team. We're organizing a short, technical-focused webinar in late November aimed at engineering and platform teams: 'Productionizing LLMs: tradeoffs, runtimes, and cost controls.' We'd love to feature VantageAI as the customer speaker to talk through your recent rollout (TL;DR: how you balanced latency and quality, and the guardrails you built).

Proposed format: 30 minutes total — 15 minute customer case walkthrough, 10 minute panel Q&A, 5 minute closing. We handle slides and promotion. Dates we're targeting: Nov 18 or Nov 25 (US morning PT).

Key asks:
- Would VantageAI be open to a ~15 minute technical case study talk?
- Who would you prefer as the primary speaker (engine manager or platform lead)?
- Any compliance/PR approvals we should route early?

If you're open, I can send a short outline, logistics (AV/recording), and a draft promotion blurb for approvals. We're happy to add Vantage branding on the registration page and share a replay for reuse.

Thanks — Connor (cc'd) is the account exec and will coordinate dates.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
